resume_reason: Slice 005 executed one Godot run and identified a concrete harness defect: the parent harness creates the sandbox project and launches the child with --path C:\Temp\AlmaSandbox and --script res://tests/test_persistence_migration.gd, but the harness script itself is not copied into the sandbox. Therefore the child cannot load the requested res:// script. This slice uses the single remaining correction/validation opportunity from slice 005; it does not reset the run budget.
objective: Apply exactly one minimal test-harness correction so the sandbox contains tests/test_persistence_migration.gd before the child Godot process is launched, then perform the one remaining sandbox-startup validation run. Do not execute migration scenarios 1-14.

diagnosis.observed_failure: Child Godot cannot load res://tests/test_persistence_migration.gd after switching --path to the sandbox project.
diagnosis.likely_location: Sandbox setup in tests/test_persistence_migration.gd before child launch.
diagnosis.hypothesis: The sandbox copy step omits the harness script itself, so the child project's res://tests/test_persistence_migration.gd does not exist.
diagnosis.authorized_correction: During sandbox setup, create <sandbox>/tests if needed and copy the current workspace tests/test_persistence_migration.gd to <sandbox>/tests/test_persistence_migration.gd before launching the child. Fail immediately with an explicit harness error if directory creation or copy fails. Do not change child arguments, sandbox identity, migration logic, or persistence code.
